text: Grandson, 4, temp 38.4. Keeps covering his eyes, says the light hurts, I've had to switch the big light off. His skin is very dark so it's hard to tell colour, but I checked his palms and inside his bottom lip and they look greyish and pale, not the usual pink. He's wide awake, chatting and watching cartoons. Neck is fine, he can put his chin down to look at his toes. Do I take him in or not
